title: Guest Chat failure report compares follow-up reply with opening code
surface: Hosted native guest Chat acceptance failure diagnostic
auth_mode: signed-out guest; test harness reporting only
severity: S2: misleading exact-code failure evidence for a real same-conversation heading failure
priority: P1: repair before the next guest Chat native retest
preconditions: Resource-valid public 0.2.205 unpacked CRX guest Chat run 39373343402 against stable server 181b; separate heading-quality defect EXT-D-0263 remains open.
Owned article has distinct unpredictable opening and follow-up codes and a full unique heading. Same-conversation follow-up reaches a terminal assistant reply after multiple tool continuations.
reproduction: Run the normal guest Chat T10 flow with a grounded opening question, then its same-conversation follow-up asking for the follow-up code and full heading.

When the follow-up fails its full-heading assertion, inspect the failure observation. The waitForTerminalAnswer result has answerContainsNonce=true for the follow-up code, but catch overwrites failure_observation with a new observe call using fixture.openingCode.
The overwritten failure_observation reports answerContainsNonce=false while its sanitized latestAssistantReply contains [follow-up-code].
expected: Failure diagnostics compare the latest rendered reply with the code requested by the active turn; original terminal verdict, exact-code and full-heading acceptance assertions remain intact.
actual: The catch path always injects fixture.openingCode, including same-conversation and post-reload follow-up phases. This is a diagnostic misclassification, not an acceptance false negative: the original sameTurn.state and terminal_wrong_answer verdict correctly reflect code present and heading absent.
cause: The shared catch block hardcoded fixture.openingCode when re-observing after every failure. It overwrote the turn-specific observation already recorded before the assertion.
sibling_census: The same catch handles opening, same-conversation follow-up, post-reload follow-up, and later Values-chip stages. All stage-specific failure observations are now mapped to the active question code; no product observer or terminal-answer threshold changed.
reproducibility: Deterministic source regression. A focused VM/DOM test executes the old catch assignment through the actual observer and returns false for a follow-up reply containing the exact code; the repaired path returns true.
acceptance_criteria: RED old/GREEN repaired failure assignment exercises production observe, waitForTerminalAnswer, and a multi-continuation reply.
Opening, same-conversation, and post-reload diagnostic phases compare the correct code; full-heading absence remains a failure.
Independent source review and original guarded native retest are required before closure.
